excerpt: Most arcade ROI claims online quote best-case payback without showing their assumptions. This article builds three labeled scenarios—pessimistic, neutral, and optimistic—with transparent inputs, then models net monthly profit after payback, not just gross coin drop. Plan around the neutral case.
